about_the_game:
Sealed shut inside a rural, abandoned house for a paranormal hunting TV show.. Something is VERY wrong with Margo. Her live headcam is still rolling.. and you can see the whole thing. Run, hide, and escape the house in this first-person survival horror. And remember: the raccoon knows everything.

DEADCAM

Set in a rural, abandonded house in the great wilderness, three amateur ghost hunters lock themselves inside to film a new episode for their failing paranormal hunting TV show 'The Ghoul Hunters.' Desperate for higher ratings, the shows producer Dom will do whatever it takes to raise the stakes and keep the show alive. 

But things take a turn for the worst almost instantly - and it's already too late. Something is very wrong with Margo. Dom fled and sealed the exit to keep Margo contained, leaving you for dead with her. And when you see Margo, you might wish you were. 

FEATURES

  • Margo's live headcam is still rolling: you can see her reactive face the whole time.

  • Watch out for any creaky floorboards and don't make too much noise: Margo can hear your movements.

  • Margo's face will respond to your characters actions. 

  • You must sneak, hide, and escape the house. And whatever you do, stay away from Margo.

  • Trust the Raccoon. 

Will you make it out alive - or will you become the final episode that never aired? If you want to survive.. The Raccoon may be your only ally.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
